documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Upcoming Board Meeting Of The Company.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: RBZ Jewellers Limited reported a strong financial performance for Q1 FY27, with revenue from operations growing 60% year-on-year to INR 121 crores, driven by robust consumer demand and higher jewellery sales. EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR 18 crores with a margin of 14.9%, while profit after tax was INR 9 crores translating to 7.5%. The management detailed upcoming store expansions in Surat, Rajkot, Gandhinagar, and Maninagar scheduled across Q2 and Q3 FY27, and highlighted a long-term strategic transition towards expanding its retail footprint and utilizing Gold Metal Loans for inventory hedging. RBZ Jewellers reported strong operational and financial performance for Q1 FY27, with operational revenue increasing by approximately 60% year-on-year to INR 1,208 Mn and PAT reaching INR 91 Mn. Management highlighted that revenue growth was in line with guidance shared in the previous quarter, supported by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.

guidance.claim: The company delivered a quarterly performance with revenue growth in line with guidance shared in the previous quarter.
guidance.quote: Delivered a healthy quarterly performance, with revenue growth in line with the guidance shared in the previous quarter, driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.

guidance.claim: Management targeted maximum utilization of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26.
guidance.quote: Targeting maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that IIJS has been warm, encouraging, and yielded good buyer growth and order backing for the company.
demand_outlook.quote: So IIJS has been really warm this time, like it was really good this time. It was encouraging and we have seen a buyer growth. We have seen a good order backing.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects demand and performance for Quarter 2 to be in line with previous commentaries.
demand_outlook.quote: I think Quarter 2, we think that because of the orders and all, we are hoping that performance will be very much in line with whatever we have projected in earlier commentaries.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand side looks to be good and promising for Quarter 2 as it approaches.
demand_outlook.quote: And the demand side looks to be good and promising for Quarter 2, as we are approaching.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth was driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue increased by ~60% year-on-year, driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that they continue to witness steady consumer demand in the occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to witness steady consumer demand in occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season, while also optimizing our inventory mix with a greater focus on lightweight and budget-friendly product offering to cater to evolving consumer preference.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that April business has been very good.

capex_expansion.claim: Management indicated that Surat will be launching in Quarter 2 and Rajkot, Maninagar, and Gandhinagar will be launched in Quarter 3.
capex_expansion.quote: So, Surat will be launching in Quarter 2 and Rajkot in early Quarter 3. And same, I think Maninagar and Gandhinagar both will be launched in Quarter 3 itself. So three stores in Quarter 3 and one store in Quarter 2, that is Surat.

capex_expansion.claim: Large format stores have a typical carpet area of around 10,000 square feet and mid format stores have 5,000 square feet carpet area.
capex_expansion.quote: The large format stores are typically around 10,000 square feet carpet area and mid format stores are 5,000 square feet carpet area.

capex_expansion.claim: Inventory deployment in large format stores is typically around INR 125 crores to INR 150 crores, while in small format stores it is around INR 50 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The inventory deployment in large format stores is typically around INR125 crores to INR150 crores. While in small format stores are around INR50 crores, plus and minus 10%, 15%.

capex_expansion.claim: The capital expenditure break-even for the stores will be achieved in a year or less.
capex_expansion.quote: The capex when you say about the break-even point, the capex break-even will be achieved in a year or less.

capex_expansion.claim: Approximately INR 10 crores is the capex incurred for the Surat store.
capex_expansion.quote: Approximately INR10 crores is the capex incurred for Surat store.

capex_expansion.claim: Retail expansion remains on track with flagship showrooms in Surat and Rajkot, alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar and Gandhinagar.
capex_expansion.quote: Retail expansion remains on track, with flagship showrooms in Surat (by Q2) and Rajkot (by early Q3), alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar (Ahmedabad East) and Gandhinagar, aimed at strengthening geographic presence and enhancing direct customer access across high-growth Gujarat markets.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that retail showrooms in Surat and Rajkot are both targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: On the retail front, encouraged by the strong performance of our Ahmedabad store, we are now planning to expand in other key Gujarat markets, including Surat and Rajkot, both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Management noted they are actively exploring strategic locations in Eastern Ahmedabad and nearby cities such as Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, we are actively exploring strategic location in Eastern Ahmedabad and nearby cities such as Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet and aimed at strengthening the regional presence and driving incremental growth.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that a typical large format store will need an inventory of somewhere around INR125 crores to INR150 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: A typical large format store will need an inventory of somewhere around INR125 crores to INR150 crores.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the quarter was INR 18 crores with EBITDA margins coming in at 14.9%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter is INR18 crores reflecting a healthy growth of 39% Y-o-Y, with EBITDA margins coming in a healthy 14.9%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for the quarter was INR 9 crores translating to a PAT margin of 7.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax for the quarter has been 28% at INR9 crores translating PAT at 7.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that average gold rates remained stagnant, resulting in negligible inventory gain in the system.
margins_costs.quote: One is that the average gold rate has remained stagnant and thus there is negligible inventory gain in the system as of now.

margins_costs.claim: Amortization of lease assets was stated at INR 76 lakhs and the impact of lease liabilities at INR 115 lakhs.
margins_costs.quote: The amortization of lease assets is INR76 lakhs and the impact of lease liabilities is at INR115 lakhs.

margins_costs.claim: For financial year 2026, EBITDA margins improved to 14.44% with an expansion of 233 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: For the financial year 2026, revenue from operations stood at INR637 crores, reflecting the growth of 20% year-on-year. EBITDA for the year increased significantly by 43% to INR92 crores, with EBITDA margins improving to 14.44% and expansion of 233 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated retail gross margins would be around 12% to 14%, wholesale around 7% to 8%, and B2B around 6% to 7% and 8%.
margins_costs.quote: retail would be around 12% or 14% GP. Wholesale will be around 7% to 8% GP. B2B will be around 6% to 7% and 8% GP.

orders_capacity.claim: Total manufacturing capacity remains at around 1.8 to 2 tons a year.
orders_capacity.quote: The total capacity still remains at around 1.8 to 2 tons a year.

orders_capacity.claim: Factory capacity utilization is running at around 50%, utilizing approximately 900 kgs to 1000 kgs.
orders_capacity.quote: And the production that we are doing or the consumption that we are able to do is somewhere around 900 kgs to 1000 kgs. So, we are utilizing factory at around 50% of capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: During core season times like July, August, and September, capacity utilization generally goes to 75% to 85% minimum.
orders_capacity.quote: In the season times, currently as of now, our capacity utilization generally goes at 70%, 80% minimum, 75%, 85% sometimes, depending on which days are all, sometimes it is near to 90% or so. But not on the off-season time, these are the core season times July, August, September.

orders_capacity.claim: During the quarter, the company launched 730 new designs averaging 8 designs per day primarily in the occasion wear segment.
orders_capacity.quote: During the quarter, we launched 730 new designs averaging 8 designs per day, primarily in occasion wear segment further strengthening our product portfolio,

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the current capacity utilization is approximately 50% or 55%.
orders_capacity.quote: The capacity utilization is approximately 50% or 55%.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated there is a sanctioned debt of around INR 300 crores which is yet to be utilized and remains sufficient for the four stores coming in this financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: Given that we have a sanctioned debt of around INR300 crores. And we are yet to utilize it, which is sufficient for the four stores that is coming in this financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that by the end of this financial year, the debt-to-equity ratio will still remain below 1:1, estimated at 0.8 debt to 1 equity.
capital_allocation.quote: By the end of this financial year, we will be still below 1:1 ratio. I guess 0.8 will be debt and 1 equity.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated they want to keep the debt levels at 1:1 ratio ideally or leverage to 1.4, 1.5, and around 1:1.2 at peak debt for the four showrooms during the fiscal year.
capital_allocation.quote: We want to stay -- we want to keep the debt levels at 1:1 ratio ideally or 1:1 point, maybe leverage to 1.4, 1.5. But generally, right now, I think for these 4 showrooms, it will be around 1:1.2 at peak debt, at least for this fiscal year that I am understanding.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the B2B to B2C revenue mix is targeted to be 50-50 in a year or two, and 75-25 in the long term with retail making up 75%.
management_commitments.quote: I think the B2B to B2C mix has to be 50-50 or so in a year or two and in long term it will be 75-25, 75 being retail.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the corporate sales mix for 18 caratage to reach at least 20% by the end of the year.
management_commitments.quote: I see by the end of this year, it will be at least 20% will be of 18 caratage.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that transitioning the entire inventory to be hedged via Gold Metal Loans will take a period of three years.
management_commitments.quote: But that will take three year of time that I, as you have said. So slowly and steadily, yes, we are moving towards hedging.

management_commitments.claim: Management targeted maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26.
management_commitments.quote: Targeting maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that both Surat and Rajkot showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: On the retail front, encouraged by the strong performance of our Ahmedabad store, we are now planning to expand in other key Gujarat markets, including Surat and Rajkot, both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
